name: cursso
description: Shared libc SP3: a curses program linked dynamically against libcurses.so, libtermlib.so and libc.so and bound on the host: initscr/addstr/refresh/endwin on the console, curses's core data (LINES, COLS, stdscr) read by the program, and termlib's UP, which curses's setterm fills and the program reads through its own import.
